q: When an organization member is blocked (status Blocked / locked) from the Admin side, what does the storefront company members list show for them, and what does the GraphQL/REST API return?

subject: A membership lock shows on the storefront members list as a red "Blocked" badge, and in xAPI only as Contact.isLockedInOrganization — the status fields stay "Approved".
Setting a contact's Status to "Locked" in Admin leaves the storefront members roster showing that member as "Active" — the membership status masks it.
Contact.isLockedInOrganization is resolved from the CALLER's JWT organization claim, so a platform-admin token reads false for a genuinely locked member.

Two platform API calls fail silently unless called exactly right: account lock needs the user id (by userName it returns succeeded:false), and member search needs deepSearch:true or it returns a totalCount with an empty results array.

saw: On vcst-qa (storefront 2.58.0-pr-2467-1f40-1f40b001) the roster query DOES request a lock field and one lock axis does reach the Active column: getOrganizationContactsQuery selects isLockedInOrganization alongside status, and a membership lock (POST /api/customer/organization-memberships/{id}/lock) renders the row as a red "Blocked" badge, flipping to Active on unlock and back to Blocked on re-lock. The entry's headline still held here — locking the security account itself (POST /api/platform/security/users/{id}/lock, lockoutEnd 9999-12-31) left the row green and Active, as did setting the contact-level Status to Locked. So the roster is blind to two of the three axes (account lockout, contact status) but not to the per-organization membership lock; the entry's universal phrasing "requests NO lock or account-status field at all ... no account state can reach the column by any path" is what does not hold. All the entry's own observations are vcptcore_stable, so this may be a build difference rather than the entry being wrong where it was taken.
